content.name: Component Pouch
entries: A component pouch is a small, watertight leather belt pouch that has compartments to hold all the material components and other special items you need to cast your spells, except for those components that have a specific cost (as indicated in a spell's description).

content.name: Component Pouch
entries: A Component Pouch is watertight and filled with compartments that hold all the free Material components of your spells.
